divisions.title: The Night Visions
divisions.theme: Eight visions of restoration and judgment
divisions.summary: Horsemen among the myrtles, horns and craftsmen, the measuring line, Joshua the high priest, the lampstand and olive trees, flying scroll, woman in the basket, four chariots.

divisions.title: Fasting and Future
divisions.theme: From ritual fasting to genuine obedience
divisions.summary: Should we keep fasting? Justice and mercy matter more. Jerusalem will be called the faithful city, old men and children will fill her streets.

divisions.title: Two Oracles
divisions.theme: Messianic prophecies and the Day of the Lord
divisions.summary: King comes humble on a donkey, the good shepherd rejected for thirty silver, they will look on him whom they pierced, living waters from Jerusalem, the Lord will be king over all the earth.
